name: profile-cover
description: Design your GitHub profile README as an editorial page. Kerned serif mastheads as path-outlined SVGs with zero external resources, light and dark pairs, GitHub-native markdown links, and deterministic checks. Nothing that can show a broken image. Use for a profile README, personal masthead, or replacing widget and badge clutter.
